PluginData.Tooltip: Client-side finite RCS and thruster-leverage attitude-control prototype.
PluginData.Description: Client-side Realistic ACS prototype. Finite ion and hydrogen RCS clusters, ordinary-thruster leverage, persistent rotational inertia, and inertial-dampener-following rotational arrest. Use /acs arm or /acs disarm for master control. Not multiplayer-safe: this build applies local physics only.
